about: PRD 0014 RF3: what macOS stores for every widget a user placed. A widget kind keeps its configuration intent forever, and intents, their parameters and enum cases are append-only: macOS saves each placed widget as its kind plus the intent's identifier, parameter names and enum case identifiers, and a widget whose saved intent no longer resolves draws an empty card until it is removed and placed again (0.87.0 changed the History intent). To change one, add a new kind or a new parameter. Checked by crates/cuotai-core/tests/widget_contract.rs (sources) and check-appex.sh (the built extension). See AGENTS.md (Testing & QA, macOS widgets) and docs/widgets.md.
